verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.asana.com that tells agents to append .md to any docs page for markdown. The .md doc URLs actually resolve across webhooks, client libraries, MCP and reference pages, and an official OpenAPI spec is published on GitHub, giving agents machine-readable API docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a richer curated llms.txt index (the probed file's description is generic), and the OpenAPI spec is not served at a discoverable docs-site path.
